Welcome to Suffah Primary School!
Choosing the right school for your child is one of the most important decisions a parent can make for the future of your children. At Suffah Primary School, we understand this responsibility fully — which is why we offer something truly unique: a balanced education where strong Islamic values and high academic standards go hand in hand.
Core Subjects
English, Mathematics, Science, Qur’an and Islamic Studies are core subjects in our school.
Foundation Subjects
Arabic, History, Geography, ICT, Art / DT, RE and PE are the foundation subjects in our school.
Suffah Values
• S – Success Every step forward is a success worth celebrating. Success is growing, learning, and doing your best.
• U – Ummah Working together with kindness, respect, and brotherhood/sisterhood. We look after and care for each other.
• F – Future Learn today, lead tomorrow. Today’s learning is tomorrow’s opportunity.
• F – Flourishing We aim high, develop resilience, and encourage every child to thrive academically, spiritually, and personally.
• A – Ambition Aim high, work hard, make it happen. Turn your dreams into your reality.
• H – Humanity Kindness matters, respect counts, care connects. Treat others how you wish to be treated.
Play Ground
A fun, safe, and engaging playground where children can play, learn, and grow together.
Healthy food
Our healthy food program offers fresh, nutritious meals and snacks that help children grow, learn, and thrive in a happy and healthy environment.
Arts and Crafts
Arts and Crafts encourage children to explore their creativity and express their ideas through fun and engaging activities.
Best School For Your Children
Suffah Primary School has been established to provide our children an environment which is conducive to excellence in learning and has a warm and caring Islamic ethos in which children can realise their full potential.
The school runs a comprehensive programme based on the National Curriculum, with a strong emphasis on Numeracy, Literacy and Science. This is supplemented by Islamic studies, Qur’an and Arabic.
No Compromise on good academic learning.
Our Classes
Nursery
Our Nursery Class provides a warm, caring, and stimulating environment where young children begin their learning journey through play, exploration, and social interaction.
Reception
The Reception Class helps children build confidence, independence, and essential early literacy and numeracy skills through engaging and creative learning experiences.
Primary (Years 1 to 6 )
From Years 1 to 6, students develop strong academic foundations, critical thinking skills, good character, and a love for lifelong learning through a balanced and inspiring curriculum.
Morning Registration
Excellence in Education with a Strong Islamic Foundation
At Suffah School, Islamic Studies, Arabic, and Quranic education form the heart of our curriculum, delivered with care, authenticity, and excellence. We teach the Holy Quran with correct recitation and understanding, helping students develop a meaningful connection to Allah’s words. Our Arabic lessons build strong reading, writing, and conversational skills, opening the door to deeper knowledge of the faith. Through Islamic Studies, pupils learn the life of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, the teachings of the Quran, and the values of compassion, honesty, and responsibility. We do not just teach these subjects in isolation — we help our students live their faith confidently, equipping them with the knowledge and character to succeed both in this life and the Hereafter.
Information for Visitors
Visitors to the school are requested to wear modest clothing. We kindly request that shoulders are covered & skirts/dresses for female visitors are ankle length.
What Parents Say!
Our daughter loves going to nursery every morning and is always so happy when we pick her up and loves talking about her day. She's grown in confidence and made so many friends. Suffah nursery has been a great place for her to learn and grow and have fun. Thank you to everyone at Suffah
I'm very happy with the Reception team, they make a tremendous effort to engage their little learners. The learning packs have been brilliant! Jazak' Allah to all the staff.
The home learning packs provided have been very useful and well thought out. The blogs are informative and children feel proud and involved when their work is displayed and like to see what their peers have done.
The online lessons have highlighted the high standard and quality of education at Suffah. The classroom teachers ability to relate to her students and bring the lesson to life was incredible and pleasing to watch. She was able to keep the attention of her students for the full duration of the lesson, which is a credit to her ability, qualifications and skills. I can’t praise the teachers enough and the Management for all your efforts for overseeing our School. May Allah reward you all for your efforts.

Dear Parents and Carers,
‏اَلسَلامُ عَلَيْكُم وَرَحْمَةُ اَللهِ وَبَرَكاتُهُ
I hope this message finds you well. My name is Waqas Choudhery, and it is with great gratitude and excitement that I introduce myself as the new Headteacher of Suffah Primary School. I consider it a profound privilege to join this wonderful community, and I look forward to working alongside our dedicated staff, supportive parents, and most importantly, our inspiring students.
Our school stands upon a beautiful foundation: to nurture young minds rooted in Islamic faith, character, and ethics, while equipping them with the knowledge, skills, and confidence to thrive in the modern world. My vision builds upon this legacy, guided by the values of the Qur’an and Sunnah, and focused on three key pillars:
✅ Excellence in Education
We will strive for high academic standards across all subjects, encouraging curiosity, critical thinking, and a lifelong love of learning. Every child will be supported to reach their full potential, whatever their ability.
✅ Strong Islamic Identity & Character
We aim to develop students who are proud of their faith, show kindness, honesty, and respect to all, and understand their responsibilities to family, society, and the wider world. Good manners and moral conduct will be at the heart of everything we do.
✅ A Supportive, Inclusive Community
Education is a partnership. I believe that when school, home, and community work together, our children flourish. I am committed to open communication, listening to your views, and ensuring every student feels safe, valued, and happy here.
I look ahead with optimism and hope, ready to lead our school forward with integrity and dedication. May Allah guide us all and bless our efforts in raising a generation that is successful in this life and the Hereafter.
Please do not hesitate to get in touch if you have any questions or ideas — I am here to listen and work together
What Parents Say!
Our daughter loves going to nursery every morning and is always so happy when we pick her up and loves talking about her day. She's grown in confidence and made so many friends. Suffah nursery has been a great place for her to learn and grow and have fun. Thank you to everyone at Suffah
Parents can observe online lessons and it was very impressive. The quality of teaching was excellent and the teachers ability to relay the knowledge to the young students was unmatched.
I'm very happy with the Reception team, they make a tremendous effort to engage their little learners. The learning packs have been brilliant! Jazak' Allah to all the staff.

At Suffah Primary School we value the diversity of backgrounds of all pupils, families and wider school community.
Our curriculum takes a global approach to learning by introducing themes from the perspective of other people in other countries.
The Department for Education states that there is a need:
“To create and enforce a clear and rigorous expectation on all schools to promote the fundamental British values of democracy, the rule of law, individual liberty and mutual respect and tolerance of those with different faiths and beliefs”.
The Department for Education defines British Values as follows:
Our school reflects British values in all that we do. We aim to nurture our children on their journey through life so they can grow into safe, caring, democratic, responsible and tolerant adults who make a positive difference to British society and to the world. We encourage our children to be creative, unique, open-minded and independent individuals, respectful of themselves and of others in our school, our local communityand the wider world.
At Suffah, we actively promote British values in the following ways:
Support for equality of opportunity for all
DEMOCRACY
RULE OF LAW
INDIVIDUAL LIBERTY
MUTUAL RESPECT AND TOLERANCE OF THOSE WITH DIFFERENT FAITHS AND BELIEFS

I am Zubair Awan, and I am pleased to introduce myself as the newly appointed Chair of Governors at Suffah Primary School.
It is an honour and a privilege to serve in this role.
At Suffah, we believe that education is a collaborative effort involving not only our dedicated staff but also our wonderful families. Together, we create an environment where every child can thrive, learn, and grow. As Chair of Governors, I am committed to fostering strong partnerships and ensuring that our school remains a place of excellence.
Our vision is simple: to provide a nurturing and inspiring setting where each child’s unique talents are celebrated.
I invite you to join us on this exciting journey. Whether you’re a parent, guardian, or community member, your involvement is crucial. Let’s work together to create a supportive and enriching experience for our children.
Feel free to reach out to me with any ideas, suggestions, or concerns. You can contact me via email at [email protected] or visit our website for more information. I look forward to meeting you all and making a positive impact on the lives of our students.

Introduction To Our Curriculum
At Suffah Primary School, we believe in a curriculum that not only adheres to the National Curriculum standards but also nurtures each child’s unique potential. Our educational approach is designed to provide students with a strong academic foundation while fostering their personal and moral development.
Core Subjects
The core subjects at Suffah Primary School — English, Mathematics, Science, Islamic Studies, and Qur’an — form the backbone of our curriculum. These subjects are essential for developing critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and a deep understanding of the world around us.
Foundation Subjects
Our foundation subjects offer students a well-rounded education, allowing them to explore diverse fields of knowledge and creativity. These subjects include Geography, History, Arabic, ICT, Art, Music, Design Technology, Physical Education, and PSHE & Citizenship.
Educational Values
At Suffah Primary School, our mission is to inspire academic excellence across all National Curriculum subjects, nurturing curious learners who are prepared to be responsible, active members of the local, national, and global community. We strive to lay a strong foundation for our students, empowering them to become confident, articulate, and knowledgeable leaders of tomorrow.
Celebrating Diversity
Suffah Primary School is proud to be a multicultural institution. We teach our children to recognise, respect, and celebrate different cultures, backgrounds, and beliefs, equipping them for life in modern Britain.
Spiritual Growth
We emphasis nurturing a strong spiritual connection with God, grounding our students in moral and ethical values that guide their daily lives.
Holistic Development
Our curriculum encourages students to become responsible, well-rounded, socially aware, and confident citizens. We promote both physical and mental well-being, emphasising the importance of becoming self-motivated, self-directed, and resilient learners.
Inclusive Learning Environment
Designed to foster thought, curiosity, and a love for learning, our curriculum is personalised to reflect the unique needs of each student, including those who are disadvantaged or have special educational needs. We are committed to ensuring that all children thrive in our intellectually challenging environment.
Love for Reading
Reading is at the heart of all learning. At Suffah Primary, we instil a love for reading from the early years onwards, rapidly securing phonic knowledge and developing essential comprehension skills.
Academic Ambition
We are highly ambitious for our students and emphasise academic success. Our curriculum is carefully designed to be broad, balanced, and knowledge-rich, ensuring that our students know more and remember more. We plan for progression in knowledge, skills, and understanding, preparing them for future success in education and beyond.
Coherent Learning Experience
Our approach to learning is coherent and structured, with knowledge building on knowledge. We identify key learning outcomes (composite knowledge and skills) and break them down into manageable components, using robust assessment to ensure that our students retain what they’ve learned.
Subject-Specific Knowledge
At Suffah Primary, students learn through a traditional, discrete subject model, acquiring subject-specific knowledge with literacy underpinning every aspect of our teaching. We believe this approach best prepares them for future academic pursuits.
Real-World Application
We emphasise strong connections across subjects, making our curriculum both real and meaningful. Problem-solving and real-world application, including partnerships with the local community, are integral to our educational offer, creating enriching learning experiences for all our students.

At Suffah Primary School, our enriching extra‑curricular programme is designed to bring learning to life beyond the classroom, giving every child the chance to explore new interests and build confidence. Every six weeks, pupils are able to choose from a wide range of activities, allowing them to follow their passions and try something new. These sessions help develop essential life skills such as teamwork, leadership, resilience, and communication, while also supporting physical health, creativity, and social awareness. Whether through sports, arts, community projects, or practical skills, our programme ensures every child grows into a well‑rounded individual, ready to face new challenges with enthusiasm.
This half term the children have been engaged in Tag Rugby, Art, Baking, Cricket, Organic Planting, Archery, Nasheeds & Story Writing.

The Early Years Foundation Stage covers the development of children from birth to 5 years of age. It has a separate and distinct curriculum which allows children to learn through exploring, discovering and playing. The Early Years Foundation Stage provides firm foundations for children in which future building blocks of learning and development can be placed.
Your child’s early years’ experiences should be happy, active, exciting, fun and secure – supporting their crucial early development and learning needs.

At the end of the summer term, we complete an assessment called the EYFS Profile. This indicates whether your child has reached expected levels in the seven areas of learning at the end of the Reception year. These expectations are called the Early Learning Goals (ELGs).
Intent Statement
We know that each child is unique and they have their own starting point, fascinations and interests. Our curriculum reflects the nature of our intake. It is designed to recognise children’s prior learning and provide the best possible start to their school life, ensuring each individual reaches their full potential from their various starting parts.
Our curriculum is designed to enable children succeed through playing and exploring, active learning and creating and thinking critically. We also recognise the importance of cooperative and collaborative play and learning. Our enabling environments and warm, skillful adult interaction support the children as they link learning to their play and exploration right from the start. Quality interactions between adults and children and first- hand, motivating experiences provide a language rich environment that supports children not only in their education, but in their future life experiences. We intend to provide a curriculum that encourages resilience, ambition and a lifelong love of learning.
Intended Impact
Our ambitious curriculum aims to teach all children the skills and knowledge in order to reach the 17 Early Learning Goals (ELGs) set by the Department of Education. Our intent is to ensure that each child makes good progress and is equipped with the skills and knowledge to make a smooth transition into Year 1.
During their earliest years, children will form attitudes about learning that will last a lifetime. It is our aim to support children to become creative, adventurous and brave learners throughout their lives
